0.title: Prologue: The Ship That Heard Tomorrow
0.main_objective: Investigate impossible signal and reach engineering lift.

objectives.text: Inspect damaged communications console
Retrieve Emergency Access Card from fallen officer
Read Technician Hale's Data Chip
Unlock Bridge Security Bulkhead
Enter Engineering Lift to Deck 04
Locate Maintenance Tool in Workshop storage
Route emergency power grid (Battery -> Regulator -> Pressure)
Calibrate backup power grid regulator
Play Captain Ward's recorded message
[Optional] Recover Malik's personal engineering log
Proceed to Crew Habitation Deck

2.title: Chapter 2: Dead Echoes
2.main_objective: Investigate missing crew and recover Science Director's badge.

objectives.text: Examine Medical Bay admission records
Unlock Science Director Harrison's locker (Code: 505)
Listen to Dr. Sera Nahl's erased futures recording
Evade or distract the Watcher security drone
Use Science Badge to unlock Central Security door
[Optional] Find all 3 unsent messages from Technician Hale

3.title: Chapter 3: Containment Breach
3.main_objective: Halt toxic radiation leak from the S9-ORIGIN core.

objectives.text: Gather 2 filter components in the workshop
Assemble Hazard-Filter upgrade at fabrication station
Isolate biohazard valves in sequence (Helix -> Circle -> Flame)
Access Ward & Sera's discussion on erased star systems
[Optional] Recover Veyr Memory Fragment 1
Enter Core Vault security checkpoint

4.title: Chapter 4: The Core Vault
4.main_objective: Reprogram defense matrix and recover the Master Override Cipher.

objectives.text: Collect 3 master cipher fragments from terminals
Reprogram Defense Matrix (Identity, Command, Target layers)
Decrypt Captain Ward's classified confession
[Optional] Recover Veyr Memory Fragment 2
[Optional] Disable corrupted security relays
Take emergency lift to Communications Deck

5.title: Chapter 5: Whispers in the Dark
5.main_objective: Manually align transceivers and broadcast distress signal.

objectives.text: Observe the vanished star void from the dome window
Retrieve 3 dish alignment coordinates from logs
Align all 3 transceiver dishes (Alpha, Beta, Gamma)
Receive distress call from future Aegis-9
Confront The Watcher over shipboard comms
[Optional] Synchronize quantum harmonics to speak with Dr. Sera Nahl
[Optional] Recover Veyr Memory Fragment 3
Enter central lift to the Continuum Engine Chamber

6.title: Chapter 6: Final Directive
6.main_objective: Reach the Continuum Engine and choose the fate of reality.

objectives.text: Traverse the spacetime anomaly corridor
Examine the 3 holographic memory projections
Hold the final dialogue with The Watcher
Execute the Prime Directive (Ending A, B, C, or Secret)
